cmp_fleet_builder_resolve_target_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = cmp_fleet_builder_target
    ordered_military_formation = {
        limit = {
            is_fleet = yes
            has_variable = cmp_military_target_fleet
            any_scope_ship = { is_in_battle = no }
        }
        position = 0
        check_range_bounds = no
        save_scope_as = cmp_fleet_builder_target
    }
}

        create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_nuclear_submarine fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
        create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_nuclear_submarine fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
        create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_nuclear_submarine fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
        set_variable = { name = cmp_fleet_builder_result value = 3 }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:cmp_fleet_builder_result = 3 } } set_variable = { name = cmp_fleet_builder_result value = 2 } }
}
cmp_fleet_taskforce_prepare_effect = {
    remove_variable = cmp_fleet_builder_result
    cmp_fleet_builder_resolve_target_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            cmp_provider_tech_res_active = yes
            exists = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target
            has_variable = cmp_army_amphib_amount_index
            OR = { has_technology_researched = amphibious_warfare has_technology_researched = high_performance_apparel }
            any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state has_port_state = yes }
            OR = { has_technology_researched = modern_naval_doctrine has_technology_researched = modern_battleships }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_technology_researched = modern_naval_doctrine }
            create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_destroyer fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
            create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_destroyer fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
            create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_destroyer fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
            create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_destroyer fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_technology_researched = modern_battleships }
            create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_cruiser fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
            create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_cruiser fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
            create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_battleship fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_technology_researched = integrated_naval_air_tactics }
            create_ship = { type = ship_type:ship_type_nuclear_carrier fleet = scope:cmp_fleet_builder_target }
        }
        cmp_army_amphib_apply_effect = yes
        if = { limit = { var:cmp_army_amphib_result = 1 } set_variable = { name = cmp_fleet_builder_result value = 4 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:cmp_fleet_builder_result = 4 } } set_variable = { name = cmp_fleet_builder_result value = 2 } }
}
